A '''lubricant sprayer''' was a speciality [[Droid/Legends|droid]] arm. [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series]] [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droids]] could be fitted with lubricant sprayers.<ref name="RPG-Core" />
